findings.title: Expiry selection overwrites the mandatory INFRA_FAILURE for a comparator-generated output fault

example.preconditions: Valid fabricated mechanism pair; authority valid at start and initial AUTHORITY stage.
fault_and_schedule: Reject the write of reference.projection (the existing PROJECTION_WRITE fault).
Allow remaining input snapshots and candidate reports to be written, but advance time beyond authority.expiresAt before final selector.

findings.expected: A failure of the comparator or generated-output IO produces INFRA_FAILURE/1 per the explicit final sentence of SPEC precedence. Expiration may outrank an authenticated execution outcome, but must not relabel an actual comparator/output failure.
findings.actual_static: The projection catch correctly sets INFRA_FAILURE, then authorityChecked=true plus report.status=INFRA_FAILURE creates a BLOCKED_CVG_SPEC alternative. The selector chooses that alternative after expiry, publishing and returning BLOCKED_CVG_SPEC/1. No distinction is retained between authenticated execution infra outcome and comparator-owned failure.
findings.impact: The persisted report hides the actual IO failure behind an authority result, violating the frozen deterministic error contract. Saved/returned reports agree, but agree on the wrong status.
findings.proposed_remedy: Track comparator/output failure provenance internally, separately from authenticated execution INFRA_FAILURE, without adding report/schema fields. Such failures must retain INFRA_FAILURE at final selection; expiry can still block a valid semantic result or authenticated execution classification.
findings.closure_evidence: Combine projection-write failure with expiry during snapshots/publication. Assert returned and persisted INFRA_FAILURE/1; keep pure-expiry cases BLOCKED_CVG_SPEC and pure authenticated infra/authority precedence controls.
findings.related_prior_finding: R1-002 generated-output error handling: ordinary fault is fixed; combined expiry path remains defective.

findings.title: Metadata normalization can allocate a huge canonical projection before any generated-output budget check

example.raw_document: Array of 20000 copies of {"eventId":"a"}. Use bound synthetic inputs on both sides.

findings.expected: Raw bounded evidence must not bypass generated-resource accounting. Validate any applicable approved ID constraints before expansion, and check the generated normalization/canonicalization budget before allocating/hashing the expanded document. Comparator resource failure must remain an honest INFRA_FAILURE, rather than being treated as malformed envelopes.
findings.actual_static: The current namespace lexical validator has no length bound and the qualifier delegates policy validation to it. The long policy fits the raw rule/string limits and normalizeLog([],policy) succeeds. During SCHEMAS, normalizeLog(document,policy) replaces each eventId with id:<40000-byte-namespace>:1 and eagerly computes projectionDigest via canonicalJson, before the IO MAX_OUTPUT guard is reached. The result demands 800,400,001 bytes for one complete canonical string from only 320,001 raw bytes. Runtime string/heap failure is environment-dependent; a thrown range/resource error here is caught as INVALID_INPUT, while an OOM may terminate without a report. No OOM or timing was reproduced.
findings.impact: A small bounded local input can bypass the output cap at the allocation boundary and prevent a reliable report; output chunking protects files only after this eager expansion.
findings.proposed_remedy: Add a bounded generated-size preflight/accounting path before the digest-generating normalizer is invoked, using the approved finite metadata transforms, or a bounded/streaming implementation with the same kit semantics. Respect existing approved ID limits where applicable; do not silently invent a smaller namespace/input contract or clone normalization semantics. Distinguish envelope validation from comparator resource exceptions. Keep Q03 ownership/gates intact.
findings.closure_evidence: Without constructing the huge output, verify an instrumented/preflight guard rejects or reports the over-budget generation before full normalization/digest allocation, with honest status. Include a within-budget long-namespace control, unchanged protected payload/topology, and the 200k numeric chunk regression.
